entry.summary: Every visitor needs a BIOT permit; yachts need a mooring permit applied for at least six weeks ahead. Since 31 March 2026 BIOT has paused substantive consideration of new visitor permit applications, except in exceptional circumstances (notice updated 24 April 2026).
entry.next_check: Confirm with the British Indian Ocean Territory's government.
